review_scope: Fresh read-only review of the exact configured CLI and test files. The reviewer authored neither product nor tests and did not execute project code, tests, database, CI, publication helpers or private runtime configuration.

Two new explicit subcommands take a private configuration path and external development/test profile; they do not accept the three legacy numeric override flags. Production is rejected by argument parsing or the reused strict loader before any material read or output selection. No environment/default configuration source is introduced.

Secure E04 configuration is loaded once and frozen before material I/O. The same frozen values supply MaterialBudgets, all aggregate limits, handler allowlist and profile/configuration-bound digest; material paths are not re-read after the initial four reads.

Each file is individually bounded by the existing secure reader. Raw source document lengths are accumulated after each bounded read and the next read/parser is not reached once the bundle ceiling is exceeded. This is an admission/output bound, not a claim that instantaneous memory is exactly the aggregate limit.

After the real strict I01 material parser succeeds, the four canonical material lengths are summed separately and all node snapshot lengths are summed without deduplication. Equality is allowed; one byte over is refused before the output writer.

Handler allowlist checks cover every plan node and capability handler declaration after their strict cross-material relationships are validated. IDs remain data; no material-controlled import, handler execution or current release/license/availability authority is introduced.

The configuration observation contains profile/environment/revision/canonicalization/configuration SHA, three actual aggregate counters and only six explicitly enforced limits. Complete configuration hash binding does not imply implementation of every hashed field.

The common finishing helper adds development_configuration only when non-None; legacy mode retains original status, flags, serialization, digest/output/result semantics. Both configured statuses remain OFFLINE_NOT_ADOPTED and all database/network/ACTIVE/task/authority/license flags remain false.

The existing descriptor-relative no-follow/exclusive private output path, canonical manifest, output race rejection and owned-files-only cleanup are reused unchanged. Config/material/output faults are mapped to fixed safe CLI errors, without raw paths, input content or exceptions.

test_source_observed: Actual private configured prepare/validate calls, canonical artifact hashes, permissions, safe statuses, configuration digest/counters and no output in validation mode.

Real individually valid four-document raw aggregate equality/+1 cases; separate canonical numeric normalization expansion (1e2 to 100.0, two additional bytes) with raw aggregate still legal; four-node repeated snapshot aggregate equality/+1 with all per-document budgets legal.
Explicit external profile and complete config digest binding, formatting invariance, revision/profile and unused-limit changes, material hashes remaining independent from config SHA.

Configuration loaded once while its file changes later; four material paths read once. Invalid JSON/profile override/private file/parent/symlink/missing config, absent explicit options, production and three numeric override flags reject before material/output writes.
Disallowed and reserved allowed handler IDs are not imported or executed. Aggregate refusals cannot call the output writer or change an existing destination.

Existing safety scenario assertions are reused through the actual configured call chain, covering exclusive outputs, deterministic bytes, symlinks/FIFO, repository/relative paths, partial-write cleanup, unknown-file preservation, planted links and parent replacement. New real two-process configured output race and redacted injected output-fault tests are present.

All original test bytes are an exact LF prefix of the final test file; no old tests/assertions were removed, weakened or skipped. This review makes no independent runtime PASS/RED claim for those source tests.
validation_limits: ROOT owns final exact-source pure/quality/probe and hosted-CI evidence. Earlier smoke or pre-type-annotation results are not rebound to this final source cohort by this review.

No actual authority/adoption receipt validation, authenticated management grant, ACTIVE mapping, TaskPlanProof issuance, SQL/current capability/classification/recovery provider, HTTP TaskCreate or 202 is established.

Only max_material_bytes/max_nodes/max_capabilities/max_bundle_bytes/max_snapshots_bytes/allowed_handler_ids are enforced by this offline call. HTTP size, Proof/control/adoption durations, handler/DB/transaction deadlines, capability/node leases, temp/storage/concurrency/free-space budgets remain unimplemented runtime obligations.

Canonical and snapshot aggregate checks occur after parsing/materialization. They prevent oversized accepted output but do not claim streaming generation, strict peak-RSS containment, handler hard cancellation or an operating-system memory quota.
No new package/Python candidate or public contract/SQL/CI gate modification is required or approved by this review; this batch cannot close all of I02 or T034.
